newsitem.title: USA: Lindsay stake lifted by Bass group.
newsitem.headline: Lindsay stake lifted by Bass group.

text.p: A group including members of the Bass family of Fort Worth, Texas, said Friday it raised its stake in Lindsay Manufacturing Co to 1,006,199 common shares, or 15.9 percent, from 14.8 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 70,900 common shares between February 28 and March 6 at prices ranging from $46.04 to 48.04 per share.
Lindsay, based in Lindsay, Neb., is a manufacturer of irrigation systems and special metal products.
